# TASK-023 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence set by the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0014
  Path           docs/adr/0014-reports-go-out-daily.md
  Commit         6ca078bb848966bf9e398d75717e384c533a41bd
  Digest         sha256:d3d544af6856343e2f377ea805270fab5e554cf4beb05a348213efce6b3f1993

## Ruling check (added by agent, 2026-10-22)

- The cited ADR 0014 at commit 6ca078b matches the cited digest, but it is no longer in force: at mira-decisions HEAD 1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c its status is "Superseded by 0023".
- ADR 0023 (docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md, decision key report-cadence) governs: the report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time. It replaces the 06:00 time of ADR 0014; the daily cadence is unchanged.
- Cadence chosen: `daily`. `SCHEDULE` in src/report_job.js is still `'weekly'` (ADR 0002, superseded); changing it, and the 07:00 time, is the implementation step and was not done here.
